verdict.rationale: A state business-filing portal could plausibly offer scheduled or automatic filings, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only manual, wizard-driven filing and searches. The 'Electronic AR Reminder' is an agency-sent notification, not a user-configured background automation, and probes found no API, llms.txt, or OpenAPI spec to build automations on.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
